skill_name: Summarize an article about the effect of taxation on economic growth.
workflow: This article examines the correlation between taxation and economic growth from 1960 to 2008 and finds that taxation has a negative impact on economic growth in the long-term. The study also finds that lower taxes may be beneficial in the short-term, but the long-term effects are insignificant. The results suggest that the government should strive to create tax structures that favor growth in the short-term while minimizing any potential long-term negative effects on growth.
